```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 10, fig.height = 4, dev = "png", dpi = 150)
source(file.path("..", "R", "setup.R"))
source(file.path(.repo_root, "R", "plot_helpers.R"))
```

Pseudobulk differential expression (edgeR quasi-likelihood TREAT via muscat),
combined across the single-injection (ss: coc_d01, coc_d14) and re-injection
(dd: coc_24h) cohorts. Significance is called on the **raw** p-value.

```{r thresholds}
# Single visible threshold config (project defaults: raw p<0.05, |log2FC|>0.5).
P_THR   <- 0.05
LFC_THR <- 0.5
de <- data.table::fread(inputs("de_table"))
```

## DE gene counts

```{r de-counts, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
gg <- plot_de_counts(de, P_THR, LFC_THR)
print(gg); save_fig(gg, "02_DE", "de_counts", width = 6, height = 4)
```

## Volcano per contrast

```{r volcano}
gg <- plot_volcano(de, P_THR, LFC_THR)
print(gg); save_fig(gg, "02_DE", "volcano", width = 11, height = 4)
```

## MA plot per contrast

```{r ma}
gg <- plot_ma(de, P_THR, LFC_THR)
print(gg); save_fig(gg, "02_DE", "ma", width = 11, height = 4)
```

## Pseudobulk heatmap of DE genes

```{r heatmap, fig.width=8, fig.height=9}
pb    <- data.table::fread(inputs("pb_counts_dopa"))
sheet <- data.table::fread(inputs("pb_sheet_dopa"))
de_genes <- de %>% de_call(P_THR, LFC_THR) %>%
  dplyr::filter(diff != "No") %>% dplyr::pull(gene_name) %>% unique()
h <- plot_pseudobulk_heatmap(pb, de_genes, sheet, value = "gene_name",
                             title = sprintf("%d DE genes (dopa pseudobulk)", length(de_genes)))
d <- file.path(FIGURE_DIR, "02_DE"); dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
pdf(file.path(d, "heatmap_de_genes.pdf"), width = 8, height = 9); ComplexHeatmap::draw(h); dev.off()
ComplexHeatmap::draw(h)
```

## Metacluster marker volcanoes (A/B/C/D vs rest)

```{r markers, fig.width=9, fig.height=9}
markers <- data.table::fread(inputs("markers"))
gg <- plot_marker_volcano(markers, lfc_thr = 1, padj_thr = 0.01)
print(gg); save_fig(gg, "02_DE", "marker_volcano", width = 9, height = 9)
```

## Consistency check

```{r check, echo=TRUE}
# Up/Down counts at the config thresholds (re-derived) — compare against the
# pre-thresholded export variants if present in data/.
de %>% de_call(P_THR, LFC_THR) %>% dplyr::count(contrast, diff) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = diff, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = sprintf("DE calls at p<%g, |log2FC|>%g", P_THR, LFC_THR))
```
